newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times page one - March 19.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times page one - March 19.

text.p: The New York Times reported the following stories on its front page on Wednesday:
* New Federal rules would bar legal immigrants affected by Alzheimer's disease or other mental impairments, who could not knowingly take an oath of allegiance, from becoming U.S. citizens.
* President Clinton tried to give new life to budget-balancing efforts by outlining steps to encourage discussion between both sides.

* Senator Bob Kerrey, the highest ranking Democrat on the Senate Intelligence Committee, told the White House on Saturday he had strong reservations about nominating Anthony Lake as director of the Central Intelligence Agency.
* More Americans are dying in crashes between cars and light trucks, government statistics show.
* China put a senior North Korean defector on a plane to the Philippines, where he is expected to stay before going to South Korea.
* The leader of a band of Serbian mercenaries hired by Zaire's President Mobutu Sese Seko to protect Kisagani from rebels instead ruled like a tyrant.
* About 4,000 people lined up in midtown Manhattan for a shot at getting one of 700 jobs at the Roosevelt Hotel, due to reopen soon.
